places.quote: The place in Lincolnshire has shut its many eyes again
places.note: Region where the Dedlock country seat lies; not a setting in this passage.

places.quote: since their late interview in his turret-room at Chesney Wold
places.note: Dedlock country house, invented by Dickens; location given only as Lincolnshire.

places.normalized: House of Lords, Palace of Westminster, London
places.quote: like its high and dry master in the House of Lords
places.note: Used figuratively as a place where a lord sits; borderline institution.
